body:
Queue filter fields and room selection were 36px on mobile, while filter actions were 32px on desktop. Give the affected local controls at least 44px below 1024px and 36px on desktop, following Clean Look section4.

Only Queue/Index.vue and Registration/Index.vue templates change. Both scripts match current main byte-for-byte, including the current Queue additions. Independent refresh review confirms the added/removed target lines are identical to the original approved patch; no handler, permission, backend or assertion changes. Registration workspace composition remains a separate slice.

Fresh validation: all 2,205 frontend tests and the 216 existing direct-consumer tests pass, full TypeScript and production build pass, and scoped ESLint/Prettier/diff checks pass. The identical class changes previously passed 30 integrated responsive checks at390/768/1440 in both themes, including target sizes, focus, overflow and errors; those remain carried historical evidence, not a new full integrated browser run. Exact-head CI and then-current-main containment remain merge gates.
